value.rationale: Projectivity and infinite projective dimension are intrinsic homological distinctions for natural cyclic selfinjective Nakayama algebras. The exact labeled rank-profile census of an entire family, with uniform nonconcentration over d+1 projective types for even n, concentration on one for odd-even parameters, and an absolute parity-forced one-simple generic obstruction for odd-odd parameters, is structurally meaningful beyond generic subspace counting.
